lines.zh: 低吼向前，树叶沙沙作响。
lines.en: Rumbles forward, leaves rustle.

lines.zh: 缓慢移动，尾巴轻轻摇摆。
lines.en: Slowly moves, tail sways gently.

lines.zh: 树叶与枝条摩擦发出声音。
lines.en: Leaves scrape against branches.

lines.zh: 步履蹒跚，发出轻微声响。
lines.en: Tiptoes, making soft sounds.
Chewing leaves, moving slowly.
Softly leaps, landing soundlessly.
Nods head, occasionally looks up.
Leaves brush, body graceful.

lines.zh: 小心地走过地面，怕惊扰其他生物。
lines.en: Walks carefully, not to disturb others.
Chews leaves, moves slowly.

lines.zh: 我从化石里被拼回来，腿还发软。
lines.en: I was pieced back from fossils; my legs still wobble.

lines.zh: 四条腿踩着落叶，步子很短。
lines.en: Four legs on fallen leaves, short steps.

lines.zh: 我绕着蕨丛走，不敢出林。
lines.en: I circle the ferns, afraid to leave the grove.

lines.zh: 破壳后第一件事就是找叶子。
lines.en: Fresh from the egg, my first task is finding leaves.

lines.zh: 尾巴左右摆，替身体配平。
lines.en: My tail swings side to side to keep me balanced.

lines.zh: 我沿着温室的石径慢慢溜达。
lines.en: I stroll slowly along the greenhouse path.

lines.zh: 低头啃食树皮，专注而慢。
lines.en: Chews bark, slow and focused.
Lazily lies in the shade.

lines.zh: 轻摇尾巴，享受午后时光。
lines.en: Tails sways, enjoys afternoons.
Looks up, eyes hollow.
Chews hanging leaves.
Occasionally looks up, thinking.

lines.zh: 轻闭双眼，享受片刻宁静。
lines.en: Closes eyes, enjoying peace.
Chews grass, on the ground.
Twitches head boredly.
Chews moss, on the ground.

lines.zh: 我嚼着橡树叶，嚼得很久。
lines.en: I chew oak leaves for a very long time.

lines.zh: 只是十六点血的小家伙，别怕我。
lines.en: Just a sixteen-health little thing, don't fear me.

lines.zh: 我把头埋进草里，装作石头。
lines.en: I bury my head in the grass and play stone.

lines.zh: 幼体只有六点血，风大点都慌。
lines.en: As a hatchling with six health, even wind startles me.
Sees player, runs away.

lines.zh: 抬头看向玩家，警惕而怯懦。
lines.en: Looks at player, wary and timid.

lines.zh: 低吼一声，试图吓退玩家。
lines.en: Growls, trying to scare off player.

lines.zh: 靠近玩家，试探性地触碰。
lines.en: Approaches, touches tentatively.

lines.zh: 低头盯着玩家，显得害怕。
lines.en: Looks at player, scared.
Runs away quickly, avoiding conflict.

lines.zh: 观察玩家，然后继续觅食。
lines.en: Observes player, then continues eating.
Cautiously approaches player.
Attempts to touch player with tail.
Growls, then quickly runs away.

lines.zh: 你手里是叶子还是骨头？
lines.en: Is that a leaf or a bone in your hand?
You step closer; I step back twice.

lines.zh: 你的靴子上有化石的味道。
lines.en: Your boots smell of fossils.
That's a pickaxe; I'll hide first.

lines.zh: 你蹲下了，我敢多看一眼。
lines.en: You crouched, so I dare look a little longer.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，判断你不吃草。
lines.en: I tilt my head, deciding you don't eat grass.
I cannot stand steady and back into the grass.
I tuck my neck and hiss.
Continuous wails
My hind legs will not stop shaking.
Groaning loudly
Sssssing loudly
Pained howls
Sssss for help
Sssss in agony
Pained screams

lines.zh: 低鸣，你手中的叶子吸引了我。
lines.en: Growl. The leaf in your hand draws me in.

lines.zh: 看着那嫩叶，我想要靠近。
lines.en: The young leaves tempt me to approach.

lines.zh: 树枝上的果实，我从未吃腻。
lines.en: The fruit on the branch, never tiring of it.

lines.zh: 靠近些，我可以感受到你的善意。
lines.en: Come closer, I can sense your kindness.

lines.zh: 你的好意我心领了，给我点吃的吧。
lines.en: Your kindness is appreciated, give me some food.

lines.zh: 这些嫩叶对我很有效，试一试。
lines.en: These young leaves work on me, give them a try.
The grass in your hand tempts me.

lines.zh: 别怕，这些叶子对我无害。
lines.en: Don't be afraid, these leaves won't harm me.

lines.zh: 靠近点，让我看看这些食物。
lines.en: Come closer, let me see the food.
These fruits are my favorite.

lines.zh: 你撞到我了，别那么冲动。
lines.en: You've撞到me, don't be so impulsive.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片碰了一下你，别担心。
lines.en: My scales brushed you, don't worry.

lines.zh: 我只是一时疏忽，碰了你一下。
lines.en: I accidentally brushed you.
Be careful, don't get too close.

lines.zh: 我的体型庞大，你得小心。
lines.en: My size is intimidating, be careful.

lines.zh: 我的体型太大，不小心撞到了你。
lines.en: I'm too big, accidentally bumped you.

lines.zh: 你的动作太快，我避不开。
lines.en: Your movement is too fast, I couldn't avoid it.

lines.zh: 我撞到你了，我向你道歉。
lines.en: I bumped into you, I apologize.

lines.zh: 小心点，我的体型可能会撞到你。
lines.en: Be careful, my size might bump into you.

lines.zh: 我的体型庞大，你得注意避让。
lines.en: My size is large, be careful to avoid me.

lines.zh: 寻找我的伴侣，这是我的责任。
lines.en: Finding a mate is my duty.

lines.zh: 我想找一个伴侣，一起生活。
lines.en: I want a mate to live with.

lines.zh: 我需要找到我的同类，一起生活。
lines.en: I need to find my同类to live with.

lines.zh: 寻找我的伴侣，这是我的本能。
lines.en: Finding a mate is instinctive.

lines.zh: 我想要一个伴侣，一起度过余生。
lines.en: I want a partner to spend my life with.

lines.zh: 寻找我的同类，这是我的使命。
lines.en: Finding my同类is my mission.

lines.zh: 我需要一个伴侣，一起分享生活。
lines.en: I need a partner to share life with.

lines.zh: 寻找我的同类，这是我的目标。
lines.en: Finding my同类is my goal.

lines.zh: 我需要一个伴侣，一起共同生活。
lines.en: I need a partner to live with.

lines.zh: 和我一样的同类，还有多少只？
lines.en: How many of my kind are left?

lines.zh: 我闻到你的饲料了，小心点！
lines.en: I smell your food, be careful!

lines.zh: 别动，我来给你吃点东西。
lines.en: Don't move, I'll feed you.

lines.zh: 你这么弱小，吃点东西吧。
lines.en: You're so weak, eat something.

lines.zh: 快给我吃，这对你有好处。
lines.en: Eat for me, it's good for you.

lines.zh: 你得学会吃东西才能驯服我。
lines.en: You need to eat to tame me.
Try this, you'll like it.

lines.zh: 现在吃吧，我会给你更多。
lines.en: Eat now, I'll give you more.
Eat quickly, it's good for you.
Eat to tame me.

lines.zh: 吃点东西，这样你就能信任我。
lines.en: Eat, you'll trust me.
I'm coming, you can't escape.
Come closer, I'll catch you.
One kick of my legs and I run.
You can't run, I'll catch you.
Come closer, I'll catch you.
I'm coming, you can't escape.
I'll catch you, you can't escape.
Come closer, I'll catch you.
You stepped on my nest.
I'm not fierce, but I will butt you.

lines.zh: 两点的伤害，也够赶你走。
lines.en: Two points of damage is enough to drive you off.
Back off; the eggs are at my feet.
I guard the hatchlings and won't back down.
You frightened me; I'll ram you.
I'm attacking, watch out!
Be careful, I'm attacking.
I'm attacking you, you can't escape.
I'm here, be careful.
Watch out, I'm attacking.
Be careful, I'm attacking.
I'm attacking, prepare!
I'm attacking, watch out!
Be careful, I'm attacking.
I'm attacking you, watch out!
Head down, I shove my skull forward.
Hind legs braced, ready for one charge.

lines.zh: 我咬不到你，就撞你的膝。
lines.en: If I can't bite you, I'll hit your knee.
Tail taut, I pick my moment.

lines.zh: 别过来，我腿虽短也会踢。
lines.en: Stay back; short legs still kick.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶叫着，张开小嘴咬一口
lines.en: Hisses, opens small mouth to bite

lines.zh: 用牙齿狠狠地啃着目标
lines.en: Gnaws with sharp teeth at the target

lines.zh: 前爪挥动，试图挠伤敌人
lines.en: Swings its claws to scratch the enemy

lines.zh: 尾巴一扫，试图绊倒敌人
lines.en: Whips tail to trip the enemy
Clasps with claws, bites off a piece
Sisses, charges quickly

lines.zh: 用尖牙在目标身上划伤
lines.en: Scratches target with sharp teeth
Lowers head to ram the enemy

lines.zh: 我胆小吃草，别逼我踹你。
lines.en: I'm a timid grazer. Don't make me kick.

lines.zh: 用尾巴拍打，试图吓退敌人
lines.en: Whips tail to scare off the enemy

lines.zh: 小牙咬住你的袖子不放。
lines.en: Small teeth clamp onto your sleeve.

lines.zh: 后腿蹬出一脚，把你踹歪。
lines.en: A hind-leg kick knocks you off balance.
I butt my skull into your hip.
My tail whips your calf.
Crawls out of the洞穴洞穴
Stretches in the grass
Hatches from an egg, grows slowly
Patrols the forest at night
Searches for food in the bushes

lines.zh: 在落叶中翻滚，享受温暖
lines.en: Rolls in the leaves, enjoying warmth
Rests in rock crevices
Moves in the early morning light
Feeds in the valley
Hides in the tree canopy

lines.zh: 培养槽的门开了，我掉出来。
lines.en: The tank door opens and I tumble out.

lines.zh: 我从碎裂的蛋壳里站起。
lines.en: I rise out of a cracked eggshell.

lines.zh: DNA 拼成的骨头开始走动。
lines.en: A skeleton stitched from DNA starts walking.

lines.zh: 我把头探出蕨叶，先看左边。
lines.en: I poke my head through ferns, checking left first.

lines.zh: 复活的气息还没散，我就站稳了。
lines.en: The scent of revival still lingers as I find my feet.

lines.zh: 脚掌踩到泥土，我回来了。
lines.en: Soles on soil, I am back.

lines.zh: 我是从砂岩里的骨头里长出来的。
lines.en: I grew out of bones in the sandstone.
My first call is thin as a bird's.
An archaeologist's brush swept me awake.
Under the nursery lamp I open my eyes.
Burned by flames
Fell off the cliff
Drowned underwater

lines.zh: 骨粉被冲击波掀得到处都是。
lines.en: The blast scatters my bone dust everywhere.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我的尾巴，我跑不动。
lines.en: An arrow is in my tail; I cannot run.
Magic hit
I am too weak to bite even a fern.
Lightning strike
There is nothing to graze in the void.
